slot.brief: A spring balance or lift problem: find normal reaction reading when the lift accelerates up/down with given acceleration.

stem: A person of mass $60\ \text{kg}$ stands on a spring balance in a lift accelerating downward at $2\ \text{m s}^{-2}$. Taking $g=10\ \text{m s}^{-2}$, what does the balance read?

verdicts.working: For downward acceleration, the balance reads the normal force: N = m(g − a) = 60(10 − 2) = 480 N.

working:
For downward acceleration, $N=m(g-a)$.\n$N=60(10-2)=480\ \text{N}$.

Independent check: For downward acceleration, the balance reads the normal force: N = m(g − a) = 60(10 − 2) = 480 N.
solution:
For downward acceleration, the balance reads the normal force $N=m(g-a)$.
$$N=60(10-2)=480\ \text{N}$$
